cues.en:
Here, where the life-size Gundam statue towers,
the biggest Gundam event in history is being held.

"Gundam Great Front": a Gundam event packed with cutting-edge tech
under the theme "The Gundam World Becomes Reality".

Welcome to the biggest Gundam event in history,
"Gundam Great Front"!
And the biggest highlight of the event is...
the "Gunpla battle game" everyone dreamed of, finally real!

A new kind of live event using the Gunpla Battle Simulator:
"Battle Live-G"!

Can the chosen players defeat
the countless swarms of enemy Gunpla

and beat the "strongest machine" waiting beyond:
the Gundam?

The live event using the Gunpla Battle Simulator,
"Battle Live-G"!

An announcement for all
"Battle Live-G" players!

The battle system is running normally!
You can join the battle any time!

For the systems you play with
and the rules of battle,

we've sent mail to your Breakers Mobile,
so check it from the "Mobile Menu"!
Well then, do your best until the last day of the event!
We're waiting for your hot plays!
